bias.zh: 偏空 · 在 1 月低点企稳

read.en: Alphabet rose 1.2% on Oct 27 to $320.58, trading between $316.90 and $323.88, ending a run of five lower closes. It is below the falling 5-day ($323.3), 10-day ($333.9), 30-day ($342.3) and 100-day ($347.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($341.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($346.07), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月27日上涨 1.2%，收于 $320.58，盘中区间 $316.90–323.88，结束连续五日收低。股价位于下行的 5 日（$323.3）、10 日（$333.9）、30 日（$342.3）和 100 日均线（$347.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$341.2）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$346.07），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The close moved back above $319.4 (Jan 21 low) and the $321.5 Oct 26 high, while the $323.9 high stopped at the 5-day. Resistance is $322–324.5 (5-day, Oct 23 high), then $331.4 (Oct 22 high) and $333.9 (10-day). Support is $316.6–319.4, then $314.9 (Jul 23 low) and $310.3 (Jan 2 low). A close above $324.5 would target $331–334; below $316.6, $310–315.

r.en: 5-day average $323.3; Oct 22 low $322.0; Oct 27 high $323.9; Oct 23 high $324.5
